newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: One dies in blast near Sri Lanka president's house.
newsitem.headline: One dies in blast near Sri Lanka president's house.

text.p: At least one person was killed in a blast close to the official holiday residence of the Sri Lankan President Chandrika Kumaratunga in central Nuwara Eliya town on Monday, police said.
They said the blast occurred in the afternoon about 250 metres (yards) away from the entrance of the house. President Kumaratunga was in Nuwara Eliya for an election meeting.
Police said the president was not in the house when the blast occurred at about 2.30 p.m. (0830 GMT).
"We have arrested one man," a police official told Reuters by telephone from Nuwara Eliya.
Officials at the residence said Kumaratunga was at the election meeting being held at municipal grounds in the city.
No other details were immediately available.
